notes.title: All Games Free & Patreon
notes.content:
Hello, to anyone reading this.

I'm no longer planning to make any video games or visual novels for the time being.  I'm focusing on making interactive and non-interactive fiction.  You can find more and buy into all my content (more coming, of course) on my Patreon: patreon.com/Cleril

I only have one membership tier, $1, for everything.

I'll eventually be posting a demo of my interactive fiction, Mercenary, and I post new short stories at least once a month (launched just last week and already two short stories are available).

I also make board games which I may integrate into that Patreon or make a different Patreon just for that.  Currently working on a Factory Roll & Write game.

With that, I decided to make all of my steam titles completely free. I haven't made more than 100 bucks on them in years. Thanks to all of you who purchased them previously.

You can find me on itch.io as well where I'll post Mercenary when its ready for a demo:  https://itch.io/profile/cleril

Thanks for reading!

notes.title: IN CELL Release Date January 5/6th
notes.content: IN CELL will be releasing after the winter sale ends on January 5/6th to not be drowned out by the sale on the front page.  I currently can't edit the date on Steam's end but that's just a visual.
